_about: Phase D screening results. Produced by docs/migration_phase_d_screening_plan.md and consumed by scripts/migrate_phase_d_screening.py, which appends these to references/paper_tracking.csv. Every title, authors, year and journal value is the verbatim OpenAlex field for the confirmed DOI, resolved by an agent that did not run the search, with the returned title checked against the title the search agent had recorded. Manual 3.5: a DOI recalled from model weights is not a DOI.
